denver-peak-to-peak-and-trail-ridge.title: Denver · Peak to Peak and Trail Ridge
denver-peak-to-peak-and-trail-ridge.slogan: A 242 km loop out of Golden
denver-peak-to-peak-and-trail-ridge.story: Thin air, big views and no mercy for late starts. 242 km round from Golden - plan on about 4 h 39 of riding. On the way it passes Peak to Peak Highway and Estes Park. The climb of the day is Trail Ridge Road. It tops out at about 3,250 m. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.title: Greece Meteora and Pindus Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1705 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Greece Meteora and Pindus Route
scenicChapters.narrative: 1705 m come off over 55 km at around 5.4%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it — brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

greece-meteora-and-pindus-route.story: From Kalampáka it runs 159 km to Ioánnina; allow about 2 h 10 of riding. On the way it passes Meteora, Metsovo and Katara Pass. The highest point is about 1,700 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
